name: CallHippo
summary: AI-driven business phone system. Virtual numbers in 50+ countries, power dialer, call analytics and AI agents — set up your sales and support calling in minutes. Its omnichannel inbox threads voice, WhatsApp, SMS, email, Instagram and Telegram into one conversation per customer.
best_for: budget-conscious sales/support teams wanting virtual numbers in 50+ countries with a free entry point and CRM integrations
skip_if: your calling is mostly international at volume (metered minutes stack up), or you want one simple plan without add-on shopping
honest_knock: 'Unlimited calling' is unlimited to the US and Canada — international minutes meter separately, so teams calling Europe or Asia should price their real destinations first. The plan grid is busy (two suites, add-ons for the dialer and AI), which makes comparisons slippery: list the five features you actually need and find the cheapest tier that truly contains all five.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per user a month billed annually
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-15 in a browser on callhippo.com/pricing, currency selector on USD, phone-number region US/CA, team size 1-4) Starter is $19 per user per month on annual billing and $25 month to month, Professional $30 and $40, Ultimate $42 and $55. Read the tab before the number: the grid opens on yearly, so the lower column is what most write-ups quote, and the toggle beside it advertises "Save 3 Months' Cost" -- paying annually is a third cheaper per user. The $18 that a plain fetch kept printing for Starter was the placeholder sitting in the HTML before the pricing script runs, not a column any visitor is shown. Basic still costs nothing, but fair-usage note 8 lower on that page says it is free only for the first 6 months from signup, after which the account must move to Starter to keep working - so Basic is a long runway, not a permanent free tier. Starter also states a MINIMUM OF 2 USERS and includes 1,000 calling minutes within US/CA plus 100 SMS; unlimited US/CA minutes start one step higher at Professional (500 SMS), which is also where call recording, AI voicemail transcription and multilingual IVR begin. Ultimate adds smart DID, multilevel, holiday and CRM-based VIP routing with 1,000 SMS. Two different Enterprise cards sit on this page and they state different floors: the Core one a minimum of 20 users, the call-centre 'New Enterprise' a minimum of 50, both quote-only with unlimited calling to 48 countries. The call-centre 'Pro Suite' ran $32-48/user/mo annual when it was last read on 15 August 2026. 10-day free trial on the paid tiers. Add-ons are priced apart: AI Voice Agent $45/user/mo with calling billed separately at $0.25/min, AI Copilot $10/user/mo, a dashboard-user seat $15/user/mo, CNAM $100 one-time, SMS Services from $3/mo with a $20 one-time setup fee, Spam Watch $3 per number/mo for US and Canada, $100 per number for spam remediation, $239 for 1,000 UAE minutes and $0.12 per branded call. Overages are in the notes: incoming minutes on standard numbers $0.02/min, incoming SMS $0.01 per message past fair use, outgoing calls to the same number capped at 10 per hour, and parallel calls capped at 30% of total call capacity. The currency selector prices per market instead of converting: the same grid read EUR 19/29/39 in euros on 15 August 2026, below the dollar column rather than above it.
